status.benchmarkSizing: Start with cash. The launch UTC candle is the first prospective signal candle; the first execution opportunity is its day i+2. Passive ETH/BTC each buy once with the same $1,000/10% cap, retain remaining cash, and never rebalance.
status.valuationConvention: Values are as of recordedAtMs. Inventory is marked to fresh verified bid less assumed exit fee; stale or unavailable inventory quotes produce null P&L. Drawdown is sampled, not a complete intraday maximum.

spec.feeAssumption: Public entry-tier spot taker fee; no private account fee tier assumed.
spec.executionContract: Signal candle i trades in the first 60 seconds of UTC day i+2 using a fresh checksum-verified book. Missed windows are recorded, never backfilled. At most one fill per account per day; partial residual exits wait for a subsequent eligible daily cash signal. No additions to open positions.
spec.forwardDifference: Daily signal and sizing are frozen. Executable book walking, 5% displayed-depth participation and missed fills replace historical OHLC prices plus 3bp assumed slippage. These are prospective paper execution assumptions, not guaranteed exchange fills.
spec.launchContract: Start with cash. The launch UTC candle is the first prospective signal candle; the first execution opportunity is its day i+2. Passive ETH/BTC each buy once with the same $1,000/10% cap, retain remaining cash, and never rebalance.
